name: brunos-knowledge-base
description: Opens knowledge-base files the way they are meant to be read: Markdown pre-rendered with mermaid diagrams, .diff and .patch coloured green and red.

brunosMarkdownReader.showGitHeader.description: Show the git header (last commit + file history) at the top of the rendered view.

brunosMarkdownReader.historyExpanded.description: Start the commit History panel expanded instead of collapsed.

brunosMarkdownReader.doubleEscToPreview.description: When editing a file opened from the reader, press Esc twice to return to preview.

brunosMarkdownReader.editMode.description: BETA: Notion-like experience. Replace the rendered reader with the Vditor instant-render (IR) editor, editing the file in place.

brunosMarkdownReader.collapsibleHeadings.description: Show a fold arrow next to each heading in the reader, to collapse everything under it. Reader only. Folds reset when the file is reopened.

brunosMarkdownReader.resizableColumns.description: EXPERIMENTAL: drag the divider in a table's header row to set a column's width by hand. A resized table wraps its cells instead of growing. Widths are per session and reset when the file is reopened.

brunosMarkdownReader.maxColumnWidth.description: How wide a table column may get, in pixels, before its text wraps. Without a cap a long cell stretches its column across the whole pane on one line. 0 turns the cap off. A single inline code span longer than this still stays whole, widening its column past the cap.

enumDescriptions: Grow the table both ways from the centre of the page.
Keep the table's left edge on the text column and grow to the right only.
brunosMarkdownReader.tableOverflow.description: How a table wider than the text column grows. Applies to both the reader and edit mode.

enumDescriptions: Follow VSCode, which follows your system theme.
Always render light, whatever VSCode is set to.
Always render dark, whatever VSCode is set to.
brunosMarkdownReader.theme.description: Which palette the reader paints itself with. Applies to the page, mermaid diagrams and code highlighting, in both the reader and edit mode.
